secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_GTM_ID
secrets.description: Google Tag Manager container ID (e.g. GTM-XXXXXX). Public browser identifier, not a secret. Optional — blank disables tracking but the shop still works.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_COOKIEBOT_ID
secrets.description: Cookiebot Domain Group ID (UUID format). Public browser identifier, not a secret. Optional — blank disables the consent banner but the shop still works.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_ALLOWED_HOSTS
secrets.description: Comma-separated hostnames allowed for consent validation (no protocol/port/path). Optional — defaults to localhost,127.0.0.1.
